verdict.rationale: smolagents supports hierarchical multi-agent composition via managed_agents (a manager agent delegating to sub-agents) and its CodeAgent can express branching/loops inside generated Python code, but there is no documented explicit graph/workflow abstraction with declared branching, loops, or parallel step execution as a first-class orchestration primitive. missing for 10: explicit DAG/graph builder API, native parallel-step execution, and documented loop/branch constructs at the orchestration (not code-generation) level.
